fields.match: how the label derived this wnid from WordNet: 'lemmas' (the one synset whose lemma list equals the label), 'lemmas+order' (several did; the ascending rule picked one), 'ambiguous' (several synsets carry exactly these lemmas and the published one is among those the ascending rule allows; WordNet alone cannot choose, so it is listed, not guessed), 'unmatched' (no synset carries the label's lemmas; listed)

fields.wnid: the published wnid (classes.py); index order is ascending wnid order
